dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: Hey, who are you? You don't work here, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: This is Tenshukaku, the office of Inazuma's most important officials. Everyone here has a big job to do.

dialogues.speaker: Shima Masaoki
dialogues.text: If you disturb anyone here, I will happily escort you away from the premises.
